scope: Original RA2 ground-cell shroud predicates for 15 base levels times21 slope types; one flat gap anchor, provided satellite flags and64x64 cells. No original frame, renderer, bridge, air or sloped-building-placement claim.
mapping: Original tile getter reads the TMP frame byte at0x2a into Cell.Slope. tmp_format.py decodes this same byte into frame.ramp; gen_native_maps.py preserves IsoMapPack tile.height and frame.ramp separately. NativeTileInfo already persists ramp0..20. The original getter expects its loaded frame-table entries to be pointers; raw file offsets are not passed directly.

measured.queryLevel: Truncated centerZ/104; base14 with slope9..16 reaches effective15 without encoding an illegal base height.

nativeMatrix.note: Controlled flat substrate retains the valid original-map canvas and rules binding. This mechanism matrix modifies existing mutable heights and ramp metadata; it does not recreate an authored slope landscape.
